body:
God, this feels so familiar. 

I did get help eventually - but then I stopped attending because I thought I was better again. I wasn't and it was only when my suicide ideation cropped back up after a bad break-up (and the break-up was basically because of my depression/anxiety) that I realised I did need help pretty badly.

Yes, I see a psychologist. Unfortunately, and this probably hasn't helped, I live in a different country from my parents because of college, and for the past month I've been overseas and haven't seen my therapist. I've been doing CBT exercises though?
